site_settings.seo_description: Portfolio of Mara Ellison — independent designer working across brand, product and print.
hero_phrases: I design things people actually use.
I turn vague ideas into clear ones.
I make brands feel like themselves.
I sweat the details nobody notices.
site_settings.hero_intro: An independent designer working across brand, product and print — currently taking on selected projects.
site_settings.about_heading: A designer who likes the awkward middle of a problem
site_settings.about_intro: I've spent the last decade helping small teams find the shape of what they're building. Most of that work happens before anything looks like design — in the questions, the constraints, and the things nobody wants to say out loud.
site_settings.skills_intro: Tools change. The habit of asking better questions doesn't.
site_settings.experiences_intro: A decade of studios, in-house teams, and the occasional useful detour.
site_settings.works_intro: A few projects that show how I think, not just what I shipped.
site_settings.testimonials_intro: The people I've worked alongside, in their own words.
site_settings.contact_intro: Tell me what you're working on. I read everything and reply within a couple of days.
site_settings.contact_form_label: Prefer to write something longer? Send it here and it lands in my inbox.
site_settings.footer_note: Built with care. Available for selected projects.

testimonials.name: Priya Raman
testimonials.quote: Mara asked the question everyone had been avoiding for six months, and the project got simpler that afternoon.

testimonials.name: Tomas Beier
testimonials.quote: The system she built is still the thing our team argues least about. That is the highest praise I have.

testimonials.name: Aoife Donnelly
testimonials.quote: Careful, fast, and honest about tradeoffs. She told us not to build something once, and she was right.

testimonials.name: Julian Mbeki
testimonials.quote: Working with Mara felt less like hiring a designer and more like adding someone who cared about the outcome.
